HN880: Hondo Nuevo High Back Chair
Product URL: https://www.anchortex.com/products/norix-hn880-series-hondo-nuevo-high-back-chair-n700411
Manufacturer page: https://norix.com/product/hondo-nuevo-high-back/
Spec sheets: HN880.HN850 High Back Chair (Molded Plinth Base), HN880.HN851 High Back Chair (Rocker Base), HN880.HN860 High Back Chair (Molded Wood-Grain Legs), HN880.HN855 High Back Chair (Steel Legs), Hondo Nuevo Brochure
Recommended H1 and Subtitle
H1: Norix Hondo Nuevo High Back Arm Chair – HN880
Current H1: Norix Hondo Nuevo - High‑Back Chair - Anti-Ligature Construction - Model HN880
Subtitle: Heavy-Duty High Back Lounge Chair with Arms and a Seamless Vinyl Shell, on a Molded Plinth Base, Rocker Base, Wood-Grain Legs, or Steel Legs
Current subtitle: Norix Furniture Hondo Nuevo HN880 High Back Chair
Revised Product Description
Headings marked [H2] should be set as H2 on the page.
The Norix Hondo Nuevo High Back Chair is a heavy-duty, 44” high lounge chair with arms for intensive-use rooms in behavioral healthcare and correctional facilities. The high back supports the head and shoulders, and a one-piece, rotationally molded vinyl skin over a foam core gives a cushioned sit with good lumbar support. The arm height and generous seat width help residents with reduced mobility sit down and get up.
The seamless, fluid-resistant surface is easy to clean and sanitize, and a drip edge keeps fluids from running into the base. Choose a molded plinth base, a rocker base, molded wood-grain legs, or steel legs. The chair can be ganged with other Hondo Nuevo pieces, bolted down, or factory ballasted on the plinth and rocker bases.
Construction: One-piece, rotationally molded 0.25” flexible PVC skin with a softer feel, filled with polyurethane foam and fixed to a ⅝” oriented strand board base plate
TruColor Polymer: Fully compounded color for consistent color and durability
Fluid Resistant: Smooth surface is impervious to fluids and resists punctures and peeling; a fabricated drip edge lets fluids run to the floor instead of into the base
Chemical Resistance: Resists blood, vinegar, urine, feces, salt solution, and chlorine solution
Tamper Resistant: The seat is fastened to the base with tamper-resistant Torx hardware
Ligature Resistant: The molded plinth base and rocker base models have a ligature-resistant design with no internal openings
Overall Size: 30”W×31”D×44”H
Seat: 18.5” seat height and 21” seat width, with a 26” arm height
Weight: Molded plinth base 127 lbs; rocker base 127 lbs; molded wood-grain legs 121 lbs; steel legs 132 lbs
Seat Colors: Twilight, Sage, Clay, Sienna, Dove, or Raven
Base Colors: Molded plinth base in Sienna, Dove, or Raven; rocker base in Sienna, Dove, or Raven; molded wood-grain legs in Maple or Walnut; steel legs in Metallic Silver
Static Load Testing: Tested to 750 lbs
Performance Standards: Dynamic drop tested to twice the ANSI/BIFMA X5.4 impact force (250 lbs from 18”); tested to 184 lbs puncture resistance (ASTM D4833); meets ANSI/BIFMA X5.4
Flammability Standards: California Technical Bulletins 133 and 117; UL 1056; ASTM E1537; NFPA 261
Environmental Certification: GREENGUARD and GREENGUARD Gold
Cleaning: Purple Power cleaner for routine cleaning, World’s Best Sensitive Surface Graffiti Remover for tougher stains, and a thin layer of Black Magic Protectant every two months
Dye Transfer: Indigo denim dyes and some inks can stain lighter colors permanently; clean stains as soon as possible
Warranty: 10-year limited replacement warranty
Intended Use: Indoor use only
Country of Manufacture: USA
Available Models and Options
HN880.HN850 – Molded Plinth Base: Rotationally molded LLDPE plinth base, Sienna, Dove, or Raven, 127 lbs
HN880.HN851 – Rocker Base: Rotationally molded LLDPE rocker base, Sienna, Dove, or Raven, 127 lbs
HN880.HN860 – Molded Wood-Grain Legs: Rotationally molded LLDPE legs with a wood-grain texture, Maple or Walnut, 121 lbs
HN880.HN855 – Steel Legs: Welded 1.5” square steel tube base, Metallic Silver, 132 lbs
Options: Ganging kit (C011-023, or C011-025 for steel legs), locking ganging kit (C011-019, or C011-024 for steel legs), and bolt-down kit for the plinth, wood-grain leg, and steel leg models; factory ballasting (50 lbs) for the molded plinth base and rocker base
Installation and Options
Assembly: None required
Ganging and Bolt-Down: Attach ganging and bolt-down brackets when required; see Norix instructions. Bolt-down kits must be specified when ordering (factory assembled)
Ballast: The molded plinth base and rocker base can be factory ballasted with 50 lbs of dry sand or gravel; ballasting must be specified when ordering and cannot be added on site
[H2] Applications
The Norix Hondo Nuevo High Back Chair suits lounges, dayrooms, and waiting areas where people sit for long periods, and where seating has to be comfortable, easy to clean, and hard to damage or move.
Typical applications include:
Dayrooms, lounges, and activity rooms in behavioral healthcare facilities and psychiatric hospitals
Lobbies, waiting rooms, and visitation areas
Dayrooms and visitation rooms in correctional and detention facilities
Transitional housing, shelters, and other intensive-use interiors
Explore Anchortex's Behavioral Healthcare Anti-Ligature Furniture collection for more institutional furniture.
[H2] About Norix Hondo Nuevo Seating
Norix Hondo Nuevo is a modular soft seating series for facilities where furniture has to be robust, including behavioral healthcare and correctional facilities, healthcare, education, and hospitality interiors. Every piece has a one-piece, rotationally molded vinyl skin over a foam core, and the pieces can be mixed and ganged to build flexible seating arrangements.
The Hondo Nuevo series includes:
Chairs: 30” arm chair, high back chair, and 30” and 24” armless chairs
Sectional Seats: Left arm and right arm sectional seats, and a seat wedge with a back
Benches: Bench, bench wedge, and cube
Ottomans and Stools: Round ottoman, footstool, and stool
Bases: Molded plinth base, molded wood-grain legs, or steel legs, plus a rocker base for the arm chair and high back chair
[H2] About Norix Furniture
Norix manufactures durable furniture for demanding environments, including behavioral healthcare facilities, psychiatric hospitals, police stations, correctional institutions, and residential treatment centers. Explore the full line of Norix Furniture at Anchortex.

Notes and Questions
Series section: same "About Norix Hondo Nuevo Seating" section as the HN800 Arm Chair tab.
Prices checked: all 4 variants are 80% of the Norix list price ($2,453, $2,453, $2,562, $2,594 list), with compare-at = list. No change.
Ligature resistance: on the Norix spec sheets, only the molded plinth base and rocker versions say "ligature resistant design with no internal openings"; the steel leg and molded wood-grain leg versions do not. Our current page says "Anti-Ligature" for all versions, so the new copy says it only for the plinth base and rocker.
Colors: our current page says "choice of 5 durable seat colors" but lists 6. The price list and design guide give 6 seat colors: Twilight, Sage, Clay, Sienna, Dove, and Raven. Corrected.
Rocker base: the rocker cannot be ganged or bolted down (price list "N/A"); it can be factory ballasted.
Images: the 8 current images are kept. 3 of them show seat colors Norix no longer offers (Graphite, Lagoon, Pine Cone, or Wild Berry): Norix_Hondo_Nuevo_HN880_High_Back_Chair_Pine_Cone_woodgrain_legs.jpg, Norix_Hondo_Nuevo_HN880_High_Back_Chair_Lagoon_molded_plinth_base.jpg, Norix_Hondo_Nuevo_HN880_High_Back_Chair_Graphite_steel_legs.jpg. The base close-ups (Norix_Hondo_Nuevo_Plinth.jpg, Norix_Hondo_Nuevo_Molded_Wood_Legs.jpg) have the alt text "Norix HN825-series Hondo Nuevo Seat Wedge," which is the wrong product. Norix has photos in the current colors (600×600). Would you like me to add these: HN_Highback_cl_mldrv_web.jpg (Clay seat, plinth base, Raven); HN_Highback_dv_mldmp_web.jpg (Dove seat, wood-grain legs, Maple); HN_Highback_rv_st_web.jpg (Raven seat, steel legs)? And should the old-color photos be removed?
Removed: the long old series paragraph and the long old "About Norix Furniture" paragraph; replaced with the new Hondo Nuevo section and the standard paragraph used on all Norix pages.
Collections: the product is in Behavioral Healthcare, Prison and Detention Furniture, Transitional Housing, and Norix Furniture. Following your note on the Forté tabs, the collections sentence links only to Behavioral Healthcare Anti-Ligature Furniture.
